form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form; figures typed. Box B is a bare typed '0' (a written zero, not a blank cell); Box G (713.23) is printed without a thousands separator because it is under 1,000 - all other boxes carry commas, preserved verbatim. Street address, city and signature are redacted upstream by the county (black bars), so residence_city is ''. Office prints as 'Sheriff' and agrees with index.csv's 'County Sheriff'. Date box, Date of Filing and the summary page's Date of Report all read 05/09/2022. This revision labels the close box 'G' and prints no 'v.' version string. TWO SUMMARY PAGES WERE FLAGGED (4 and 5) but page 5 is the county's internal Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist (staff-reviewed 5/18/2022 twice), not a second report - this 6-page PDF holds ONE report.
